title: Chile Real Estate Scraper

comunas.title: Comunas
comunas.description: Chilean comunas to search, e.g. Providencia, Las Condes, Ñuñoa, Santiago. Accents and capitals are optional.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Type of property. TocToc supports departamento, casa, oficina and terreno.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Portals to scrape. Results are deduplicated per portal, not across portals.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Minimum price in the currency below.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Maximum price in the currency below.

priceCurrency.title: Price currency
priceCurrency.description: Currency of min/max price. Default: UF for venta, CLP for arriendo. Listings in the other currency are converted with today's UF value.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum listings for the whole run (you pay per result).

maxItemsPerComuna.title: Max results per comuna
maxItemsPerComuna.description: Spread results across comunas. 0 = no limit.

includeNewProjects.title: Include new projects (proyectos)
includeNewProjects.description: New developments show a 'Desde' (from) price and ranges of m², bedrooms and bathrooms.

includeDetails.title: Open listing pages (Portal Inmobiliario)
includeDetails.description: Adds total m², parking, coordinates, publish date, publisher and all photos. Slower; turn off for fast price-only runs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Chilean residential proxy is recommended: the portals block datacenter IPs.

description: Escribe las comunas, elige venta o arriendo y el tipo de propiedad, pon un tope en Max results y aprieta Start.
